content.text: Implement ISSUE-0002 - Read expenses from the Ledger as defensive copies.

content.thinking: A consumer that mutates the returned array would mutate the store, so list() has to hand back a copy — a shallow copy of the array plus frozen records is enough here.

content.text: Ledger.list returns defensive copies: mutating the result leaves the store untouched. Gate gate:test:ledger-retrieval is green.
